lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where three substantive things land at once: a Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA extending cost-sharing for the 2027 planning budget, plus first readings of two ordinances — one touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program and another yet to be named. That gondola money question connects directly to what SMART voters approved, so it's worth paying attention. Ouray County also has a full plate, with commissioners weighing a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration and a work session on a proposed EMS-Ridgway Fire merger that could reshape emergency response for years.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola IGA cost-sharing and reads two new ordinances.
Commissioners vote on fifth extension of active Emergency Disaster Declaration.
Proposed EMS-Ridgway Fire merger reviewed — shapes staffing and response costs long-term.
Federal funding pipeline for gondola project gets a public status update.
Early 2027 Fair Board budget review and nonprofit structure discussion on the table.
